tools.name: codat_get_profile
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated Codat account's profile (organization name, redirect URLs, features) — a quick way to verify the API key works. Codat API: GET /profile.

tools.name: codat_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies in your Codat account. A company represents one of your customers' businesses and holds its data connections. Codat API: GET /companies. Returns the paged envelope { results, pageNumber, pageSize, totalResults, _links }.

tools.name: codat_get_company
tools.description: Fetch a single company by id (name, platform, dataConnections, created/lastSync). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}.

tools.name: codat_list_connections
tools.description: List a company's data connections (each links the company to one source platform, e.g. QuickBooks, Xero). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_get_connection
tools.description: Fetch a single data connection by id (platformKey, status, sourceType, lastSync). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections/{connectionId}.

tools.name: codat_get_data_status
tools.description: Get the freshness/status of each accounting data type for a company (lastSuccessfulSync, currentStatus, dataType). Use this to check whether a dataset has been pulled before reading it. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/dataStatus.

tools.name: codat_get_data_info
tools.description: Get a company's accounting metadata (base currency, supported data types, etc.). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/info.

tools.name: codat_list_integrations
tools.description: List the accounting/commerce/banking platforms (integrations) Codat supports, with their platformKey. Codat API: GET /integrations. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_accounts
tools.description: List a company's chart of accounts (id, name, nominalCode, type, status, currency, currentBalance). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/accounts. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_invoices
tools.description: List a company's accounts-receivable invoices (id, invoiceNumber, customerRef, issueDate, dueDate, currency, totalAmount, amountDue, status, lineItems). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/invoices. Returns the paged envelope. Tip: filter with query, e.g. "status=Submitted&&amountDue>0".

tools.name: codat_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch a single AR invoice by id (full object incl. lineItems, paymentAllocations). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/invoices/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: codat_list_bills
tools.description: List a company's accounts-payable bills (id, reference, supplierRef, issueDate, dueDate, currency, totalAmount, amountDue, status, lineItems). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/bills. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_bill_payments
tools.description: List a company's bill payments (money paid out to suppliers) — id, supplierRef, date, currency, totalAmount, lines. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/billPayments. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_credit_notes
tools.description: List a company's credit notes (id, creditNoteNumber, customerRef, issueDate, currency, totalAmount, remainingCredit, status). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/creditNotes. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_customers
tools.description: List a company's customers (id, customerName, contactName, emailAddress, addresses, status, defaultCurrency). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/customers. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_suppliers
tools.description: List a company's suppliers/vendors (id, supplierName, contactName, emailAddress, addresses, status, defaultCurrency). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/suppliers. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_payments
tools.description: List a company's payments received (money in against invoices) — id, customerRef, date, currency, totalAmount, lines/allocations. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/payments. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_journal_entries
tools.description: List a company's journal entries (id, postedOn, createdOn, journalLines with accountRef/netAmount/currency). Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/journalEntries. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_get_balance_sheet
tools.description: Get a company's balance sheet, broken into periods. periodLength (months per period) and periodsToCompare are BOTH required by Codat. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/financials/balanceSheet.

tools.name: codat_get_profit_and_loss
tools.description: Get a company's profit and loss (income statement), broken into periods. periodLength and periodsToCompare are BOTH required by Codat. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/financials/profitAndLoss.

tools.name: codat_get_cash_flow_statement
tools.description: Get a company's cash flow statement, broken into periods. periodLength and periodsToCompare are BOTH required by Codat. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/data/financials/cashFlowStatement.

tools.name: codat_list_direct_costs
tools.description: List a company's direct costs (point-of-sale purchases: card/cash spend, refunds) for a data connection. NOTE: this endpoint is CONNECTION-scoped. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections/{connectionId}/data/directCosts. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_list_account_transactions
tools.description: List a company's account transactions (bank/GL transactions) for a data connection. NOTE: this endpoint is CONNECTION-scoped. Codat API: GET /companies/{companyId}/connections/{connectionId}/data/accountTransactions. Returns the paged envelope.

tools.name: codat_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Codat API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Path starts with a slash (e.g. "/companies/{id}/data/taxRates", "/companies/{id}/reports/agedDebtor"). Codat API: GET {path}.

tools.name: codat_create_company
tools.description: MUTATES Codat data — create a new company (a container for a customer's data connections). Provide a name; optionally a description, tags, or other attributes via `fields`. Codat API: POST /companies. Returns the created company (incl. its id).

tools.name: codat_create_connection
tools.description: MUTATES Codat data — create a new data connection on a company for a given source platform. Provide the platformKey (from codat_list_integrations, e.g. "gbol" for QuickBooks Online sandbox). The connection is created in a PendingAuth state; the customer completes authorization via the returned linkU

tools.name: codat_refresh_all_data
tools.description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ALL data types for a company (Codat re-pulls from the connected source platforms). Asynchronous: it enqueues pulls, it does not return the data. Use codat_get_data_status to track progress. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/all.

tools.name: codat_refresh_data_type
tools.description: MUTATES Codat state — queue a refresh of ONE data type for a company (e.g. "invoices", "bills", "chartOfAccounts", "balanceSheet"). Asynchronous: it enqueues a pull, it does not return the data. Codat API: POST /companies/{companyId}/data/queue/{dataType}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "codat_create_connection" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: codat_get_profile · Private data: codat_get_profile · Public sink: codat_create_company, codat_create_connection, codat_refresh_all_data, codat_refresh_data_type.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: codat_get_profile · Private data: codat_get_profile · Public sink: codat_create_company, codat_create_connection, codat_refresh_all_data, codat_refresh_data_type

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
